Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo runs on a fast-growing estate of devices, SaaS tools and offices across Copenhagen, Berlin and Miami. As the first operational IT security hire, you'll own the security of that environment: the devices our people use, the identities and access that connect them to our tools, and how we respond when something goes wrong.

This isn't a "follow the runbook" role. You'll sit in our IT team, assess where we are today, set the direction, and build the processes and tooling that keep Veo secure as we scale.

What You Will Do

• 
You'll be hands-on across endpoint, identity, and operational security, and you'll be the go-to person for IT security across the business.

• 
Own endpoint security across our macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android devices, including EDR, MDM, patching, encryption and hardening baselines

• 
Define and enforce our BYOD approach, using conditional access, device compliance checks and data separation so people can work flexibly without putting company data at risk

• 
Run SSO, SCIM and MFA across our SaaS applications, and own onboarding and offboarding so access is granted and removed on time, every time.

• 
Build identity governance, including regular access reviews, least-privilege access, and clear ownership of who has access to what

• 
Lead IT incident response from detection and triage through containment, investigation and post-incident review, and keep our playbooks sharp

• 
Monitor and respond to CVEs affecting our endpoints and SaaS tools, assessing risk, prioritizing fixes, and making sure patches are applied on time

• 
Plan and run phishing simulations and security awareness training that change behavior, and measure the results

• 
Drive day-to-day operational security, including alert monitoring, vulnerability management, SaaS vendor assessments, and keeping policies and runbooks current

• 
Lead our IT security work for GDPR and NIS2, from implementing controls to maintaining documentation and evidence, together with Legal and GRC

• 
Help lay the groundwork for future SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification

• 
Own our office security systems, such as CCTV and door access, working with our Office Manager

What You Could Bring

• 
You've likely spent several years in IT security or security operations, ideally in a growing tech company, and you're comfortable being the person who owns security end-to-end.

That experience tends to show up in several of the following:

• 
Endpoint and device security: hands-on with EDR and MDM tools such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Hexnode, Intune or Kandji, across desktop and mobile, including securing BYOD environments

• 
Identity and access: deep experience with Google Workspace and Entra rolling out SSO, SCIM, and MFA, and running joiner/mover/leaver processes and access reviews.

• 
Incident response: you've led real incidents end-to-end and can stay calm and clear under pressure.

• 
Vulnerability management: you track CVEs, judge real-world risk quickly, and get fixes rolled out.

• 
Security culture: you've run phishing awareness programs and can explain risk in plain language to people who aren't technical.

• 
Compliance in practice: you've applied GDPR and NIS2 requirements in an operational role. Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 is a strong advantage as we work towards them.

• 
Linux: administration and hardening experience is highly valued.

Nice To Have

• 
Scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash)

• 
SIEM experience

• 
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or GIAC

How We Work

You'll be part of the IT team within Administration & Finance and work most closely with GRC, the Security Enablement Team, and Legal. We're pragmatic; we prioritize what matters most, and we favor simple solutions that help people work securely without slowing them down.

If you match on several of these areas but not all, apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you'll own than about ticking every box.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

We want to enable all teams around the world recording their football matches without the obstacles of finding a cameraman. Democratizing football, by giving access to video analysis, that in the past only were available for the few. The innovative dual-lense camera technology records the entire pitch at all times, with two 4K high resolution sports action lenses. We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. 

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.

You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. 

Your tasks & responsibilities 
As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.

Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.

In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

• Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
• Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
• Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
• Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
• Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
• Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.

Your profile & qualifications 

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. 

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 

• Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
• Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
• Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
• Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
• Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
• Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. **The opportunity

**Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better. Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers?

**Your mindset
